title: Transformer · translate with encoder–decoder attention
summary: An encoder has read a source sentence. A teacher-forced decoder receives a target prefix. Implement one encoder and decoder layer so that every target position can consult the entire source while seeing only its own target history. Return the decoder’s vocabulary scores for all positions.

title: ResNet · Route identity and projected shortcuts
summary: A small vision runtime exports a residual stage for two spatial resolutions. Implement both paths of the stage so a stride change samples the same input coordinates on each path. A negative residual can suppress an otherwise strong detector.

title: Word2Vec · train skip-gram embeddings
summary: A text ingestion worker learns two embedding tables from token IDs. Implement the windowing and optimization code so a client can reproduce exactly which examples moved each word vector.

title: BERT · pretrain a tiny bidirectional masked encoder
summary: A masked-language-model pretrainer is being debugged on one short sequence. Assemble its deterministic input corruption, one bidirectional encoder block and the masked vocabulary head. Reserve the original token labels before changing any input.

title: GPT-2 · score a text continuation
summary: A language-model evaluator reports suspiciously good perplexity. Rebuild its miniature GPT-2 scoring path from token and learned position lookups through a supplied causal block to a tied output head. Score each next token against the preceding position.

title: VGG · Execute a configurable 3×3 stage stack
summary: An image classifier stores its feature extractor as a stack of stages. A mistaken placement of pooling silently changes the receptive field. Implement its feature extractor and track each stage's shape for the classifier head.

title: U-Net · Align a decoder with a cropped skip
summary: A tile segmenter combines a coarse context feature with a fine encoder feature. Implement the expanding path and stitch the encoder skip to the correct coordinates. A one-pixel offset changes which objects are marked foreground.

title: VAE · train with a reparameterized latent
summary: A toy binary sensor autoencoder samples a latent before predicting the sensor reading. Wire its encoder, likelihood and optimizer together so a reconstruction error can update both the decoder and the approximate posterior.

title: GAN · alternate discriminator and generator updates
summary: A one-dimensional data generator is frozen whenever the discriminator trains. Implement both optimizers so a complete round moves the generator toward examples the newly updated discriminator would call real.

title: Vision Transformer · Assemble a patch-token classifier
summary: Ship a tiny image classifier whose first token reads evidence from non-overlapping patches. Implement the patch sequence, attention and residual encoder, then send the final class token to a two-label head. A transposed patch or a misplaced class position changes every later computation.

title: Vanilla RNN · backpropagate through a delayed label
summary: A sensor sequence often receives a label only at its last timestep. Train a tiny recurrent predictor and expose the gradient that flowed all the way back to its initial state.

title: LSTM · carry hidden and cell state through padded streams
summary: Complete an LSTM inference worker that can pause for padding and later resume from exactly the state it last emitted. A user needs both the visible trace and the internal cell state for a continuation.

title: GRU · encode a chunked phrase with reset-before gating
summary: A phrase encoder gets tokens in network-sized chunks. Build the recurrent unit that compresses the phrase into a fixed vector and return a checkpoint after each incoming chunk. Splitting a phrase differently must preserve its final embedding.

title: AlexNet · Normalize competing feature channels
summary: An inference team is porting an AlexNet feature stage whose strongest detector sometimes changes after response normalization. Compute normalization across neighboring channels and feed each normalized plane into an overlapping max pool.

title: DenseNet · Grow and compress a feature bank
summary: A mobile encoder repeatedly creates one new feature channel and retains every earlier channel for reuse. Wire a dense block into a transition layer. The transition must see features in exactly the same channel order as the exported weights.

title: DDPM · corrupt a signal and run its reverse chain
summary: A diffusion experiment uses different noise schedules for training and sampling. Build both sides from a single schedule so the loss probe and the reverse sampler agree on what timestep t means.

title: LLaMA · assemble a rotary decoder block
summary: Score a short sequence using a width-two LLaMA-style decoder. Implement rotary queries and keys, a gated feed-forward branch, and the two pre-normalized residual updates. A fixed readout exposes the effect of your block on each next-token score.

title: Gemma 3 · stream a mixed-window attention layer
summary: A text-serving worker must advance a single Gemma 3 attention layer token by token. Five local layers are followed by one global layer. Implement the retention policy and grouped-query read, then verify that head sharing and cache eviction preserve the layer’s causal contexts.

title: DeepSeek-V3 · decode from latent KV into sparse experts
summary: A decoder worker keeps compressed attention history and a separate position key. After each attention read, route the token across a shared expert and selected routed experts. The load-balancing correction may change which expert runs without changing the weights used to mix its output.

title: Arcee Trinity · Train an expert load balancer
summary: A Trinity-style expert router repeatedly sends tokens to the same few experts. Implement its bias-adjusted top-k routing and SMEBU load controller. Run consecutive batches and inspect how the next batch responds to the previous load.

title: gpt-oss · decode with an attention sink and bounded experts
summary: A reference decoder reserves some attention probability for a learned sink. The sink has no value vector. Reconstruct a small token path where this attention output enters a sparse feed-forward block with the gpt-oss gated activation.

title: GLM-4.5 · Decode with normalized grouped queries
summary: A GLM-4.5 inference worker needs a causal grouped-query attention path. Process preprojected tokens one at a time. Normalize Q and K, rotate a prefix at the token's absolute position, and share each new cached key/value pair across a contiguous group of query heads.

title: Kimi K3 · Attention across residual blocks
summary: A single-token execution engine needs to retain information across network depth. Implement Block AttnRes for a stack of small branches. A depth query chooses how much each completed block and the unfinished block contribute to the next branch.

title: Qwen4-Max companion · micro-block sparse attention
summary: Long-context decoding spends time scoring old tokens. Build a two-stage causal reader from Qwen’s publicly documented architecture preview. A lightweight index selects entire historical micro-blocks. A separate attention head then reads individual tokens within the retained blocks.

title: Inkling 2 · Pack visual patches into a text sequence
summary: A multimodal serving worker receives images between fragments of text. Complete the interface from patch features to the decoder stream. Merge each 2×2 tile, project it to text width, preserve its position among text tokens, and run a supplied tiny decoder readout.

title: EmbeddingGemma 2 · Distill nested embedding widths
summary: A training worker must align a student's multimodal representations with frozen teacher vectors at several output widths. Implement direct embedding matching and backpropagate through each prefix's normalization. Use the gradients for one update of the supplied student outputs.

title: LLaDA · learn and decode by unmasking
summary: An editor asks a discrete diffusion model to fill several holes in one sentence. Implement a training loss for randomly masked tokens, then let the decoder commit its most confident predictions and reconsider the rest.

title: Tiny Recursive Model · refine latent and answer states
summary: A reasoning service can spend several cheap iterations improving a tentative answer before emitting it. Implement its shared two-layer cell, its two update rates and a halting controller. A trace of predictions should reveal exactly when a new answer became available.

title: Gated DeltaNet · implement the recurrent token mixer
summary: A streaming language-model worker runs a token mixer with a fixed-size matrix state. Implement the gated delta recurrence and its readout. The worker must be able to checkpoint the matrix and continue with new projected tokens.
